The third quarter of 2026 was another exceptionally strong quarter for the Company, with profit after tax amounting to $270.9 million, reflecting continued robust tanker market conditions and strong

• |

• |

THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIALS
The Company reported shipping revenues for the third quarter of 2026 of $332.1 million compared to shipping revenues of $107.2 million in the third quarter of 2025. The increase from the 2025 period to the 2026 period includes $219.3 million attributable to higher revenue per day and $5.7 million attributable to an increase in total revenue days.
Other revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $0.3 million compared to $0.2 million in the third quarter of 2025 and relate to technical management services provided. The decrease is due to a
reduction in the fleet size for which the Company provides third-party technical management services.
Other income for the third quarter of 2026 was $2.1 million, compared to $1.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. The income related to the distribution of equity received from The Norwegian
Shipowner’s Mutual War Risk Insurance Association.
The Company recorded a gain of $34.2 million in the third quarter of 2026 related to the sale of DHT Bauhinia, compared to a gain of $15.7 million in the third quarter of 2025 related to the sale of
DHT Peony.
Voyage expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $41.8 million, compared to $28.0 million for the third quarter of 2025. The increase was primarily due to an increase in bunker expenses of $7.2
million, an increase in port expenses of $3.5 million, an increase in broker commissions of $2.5 million and an increase in other voyage-related costs of $0.5 million. Voyage expenses generally vary depending on trading patterns during a quarter.
Vessel operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $19.0 million, compared to $18.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. The increase was mainly related to a higher number of operating
days resulting from an increase in the average number of vessels in the fleet.
Depreciation and amortization, including depreciation of capitalized survey expenses, was $28.8 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $26.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. The
change was mainly due to higher vessel depreciation of $4.6 million following the delivery of four newbuildings during 2026, partially offset by a $1.9 million decrease in depreciation due to retrofitted exhaust gas cleaning systems becoming
fully depreciated and lower depreciation resulting from the sale of vessels.
General and administrative (“G&A”) expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $4.3 million, consisting of $3.4 million cash and $0.9 million non-cash charges, compared to $4.1 million in the
third quarter of 2025, consisting of $3.4 million cash and $0.7 million non-cash charges. Non-cash G&A expense includes accruals for social security taxes.
Net financial expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $3.8 million compared to $2.5 million in the third quarter of 2025. The increase was mainly due to $4.1 million higher
interest expenses resulting from increased debt following the delivery of four newbuildings, partially offset by a non-cash gain of $2.2 million related to interest rate derivatives, compared to a non-cash loss of $0.4 million in the
corresponding period of 2025.
As a result of the foregoing, the Company had a net profit in the third quarter of 2026 of $270.9 million, or earnings of $1.68 per basic share and $1.68 per diluted share, compared to a net profit
in the third quarter of 2025 of $44.8 million, or earnings of $0.28 per basic share and $0.28 per diluted share. The increase from the third quarter of 2025 to the third quarter of 2026 was mainly due to a $227.4 million increase in operating
income, reflecting stronger operating performance during the period, partially offset by a $1.3 million increase in net financial expenses.
Net cash provided by operating activities for the third quarter of 2026 was $171.4 million compared to $60.9 million for the third quarter of 2025. The increase was due to a net profit of $270.9
million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to a net profit of $44.8 million in the third quarter of 2025, partially offset by a $99.9 million change in operating assets and liabilities and a $15.7 million decrease in non-cash items included in
net income.
Net cash used in investing activities was $44.7 million in the third quarter of 2026, comprised of $91.1 million related to investment in vessels under construction and $4.6 million related to
investment in vessels, partially offset by $50.9 million related to proceeds from the sale of DHT Bauhinia. Net cash provided by investing activities was $11.5 million in the third quarter of 2025 and was mainly related to proceeds from the sale
of DHT Peony of $50.1 million, partially offset by $26.2 million related to investment in vessels under construction and $12.3 million related to investment in vessels.
